title: Coati results document
description: What a solved energy system model says, in the same terms for Calliope, PyPSA and AdOpT-NET0. Locations, technologies and carriers are joined into keys with '::', as in 'region1::ccgt::power'.

schema_version.description: The version of the layout of this document.

framework.description: The framework that wrote the file.

framework_version.description: The version of the framework, as the file states it or as the caller named it; null if neither is known.

model_name.description: The name of the model; null if the file records none.

solver.description: The solver; null if the file does not record it.

success.description: Whether the model has a solution.

termination_condition.description: How the solver ended, in the words of the framework, or 'not_solved' or 'unknown'.

objective.description: The cost of the system; null if the model has no solution.

objective_function_value.description: The value of the objective function, which may include penalties and weights that are no cost.

timestamps.description: The times of the time series: ISO 8601 text, or the positions if the file records no times.

weights.description: How much each time counts towards a total, in the order of 'timestamps'. Present if the times count differently; the totals of the document are weighted with it, the time series are not.

periods.description: The investment period of each time, for a model with several.

scenarios.description: The probability of each scenario of a stochastic model, whose expectation the document reports.

capacities.description: The capacity of each technology at each location, by 'location::technology'.

storage_capacities.description: The capacity of each store to hold energy, by 'location::technology'.

generation.description: What each technology puts out over the modelled time, by 'location::technology::carrier'.

dispatch.description: What each technology puts out at each time, all locations and carriers together, by technology. Technologies of demand and transmission and technologies that put out nothing are left out.

demand_timeseries.description: The demand at each time, all locations together; empty if the model has no demand.

demand_by_location.description: The demand over the modelled time at each location.

unmet_demand_timeseries.description: The demand that is not met at each time. Present only if some demand is not met.

unmet_demand_by_location.description: The demand that is not met over the modelled time, at each location.

total_unmet_demand.description: The demand that is not met, all times and locations together.

transmission_flow.description: The exchange between each pair of locations, by 'a::b' where a precedes b in the order of their names.

from.description: The location whose name comes first.

to.description: The location whose name comes second.

timeseries.description: The net flow that arrives at 'to' from 'from' at each time, negative in the opposite direction.

imports_by_location.description: What each location takes in through transmission over the modelled time.

exports_by_location.description: What each location gives away through transmission over the modelled time.

costs_by_tech.description: The cost of each technology, all locations together. Lists the technologies whose cost is greater than zero; 'costs_by_location' has every entry.

costs_by_location.description: The cost of each technology at each location, by location and technology.

tech_metadata.description: The kind of each technology and what it puts out.

parent.description: The kind of the technology: supply, demand, storage, conversion, transmission, or a kind of the framework such as supply_plus.

carrier_out.description: The carrier the technology puts out, the primary one if it has several; empty if it puts out none.

display_name.description: The name of the technology for people to read, if the file has one.

color.description: The colour of the technology in figures, if the file has one.

tech_parents.description: The kind of each technology; the same as 'parent' in 'tech_metadata'.

coordinates.description: The latitude and the longitude of each location, in this order.

details.description: What else the file says, in the terms of the framework. The keys depend on the framework.

warnings.description: What a reader of the document should know about its making.

generator.description: The program that wrote the document.

framework_id.description: The framework identifier with the most detail known, such as 'calliope-v0-7-0'.

framework_family.description: The family of versions whose layout the file has, such as 'calliope-v0-7'.

quantity.description: A number. A number that is not finite is null or, if the document was written with the non-finite policy 'string', one of the strings.

series.description: One number for each time, in the order of 'timestamps'.

source.description: The file the document was made from.

name.description: The name of the file, without its directory.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
